page.overview:
Who is Meikumi Urushibarao?

Meikumi Urushibarao is a fictional entity created by Kouichi Azakawa for his light novel series Makai Shoujo R'lyeh Lulu.

Meikumi Urushibarao is an avatar of Nyarlathotep, who takes the form of an attractive female human with glasses; however, she has no true form, possessing the ability to exist in multiple different forms at the same time and can summon other manifestations, including the Black Pharaoh and the Great Calamity. As an entity from a transcendent superdimension, Meikumi is not bound by any concepts from all other universes and dimensions, as well as dwarfing gods like Cthulhu and Hastur in terms of power.

Posing as an air-headed Japanese teacher in Rhymegasaki City, Meikumi's true goal is to release chaos and destruction from the Shining Trapezohedron. (: Makai Shoujo R'lyeh Lulu)
